issue.title: Info plugin blocking on async command

comments.body:
Thanks for the issue and the detailed information.

I think you're right that we're not meant to block in the `enable()` call. I wonder why we don't always run into this issue though? :thinking:

I know, I wonder about it as well.
The only thing that I am sure, is that autopilot version is sent back from autopilot : I was able to check it with Wireshark, and all values seem ok.
Do you have an easy way for me to reproduce? E.g. with PX4 SITL?

I think I ran into this again recently and somewhat fixed it:
https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/pull/2301/commits/9405585066997c630751132d41f36547b14a0f5d
